name: EasyOCR
description: EasyOCR is a versatile OCR tool designed to extract text from images across multiple languages accurately. It combines deep learning techniques to recognize both printed and handwritten text, making it suitable for a wide array of applications such as document digitization, automated form processing, and real-time translation services. EasyOCR's robustness against various image qualities and its ability to handle complex layouts make it an ideal choice for processing diverse document types.
examples: Extracting text for document automation
Real-time signboard translation
Processing scanned receipts for expense tracking
Digitizing handwritten notes
Automated data entry from printed forms
input_examples: Scanned document with mixed printed and handwritten text
Photograph of a street sign in a foreign language
Image of a receipt for expense reporting
Handwritten notes from a meeting
Filled-out registration form for digital processing

description: MMOCR is a comprehensive open-source toolbox for text detection, recognition, and understanding. It supports a wide range of algorithms for different OCR tasks, including text detection, text recognition, and key information extraction from documents. MMOCR is designed for academic research and practical applications, offering flexible architecture and high performance on various OCR challenges.

Extracting key information from business documents
Automating data extraction from scanned forms and invoices
Enhancing accessibility through text extraction from images
Supporting document digitization in archives and libraries

Image of a signboard with text in multiple fonts and sizes
Photograph of a document containing handwritten notes
Picture of a historical document for digital archiving
Screenshot of a digital display or website for content extraction

name: Nougat
description: Nougat, short for Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents, is a specialized OCR model designed by Facebook Research for parsing academic documents. It excels in understanding complex layouts, including LaTeX math and tables, making it ideal for digitizing scientific papers, theses, and other academic materials. Nougat is built to work seamlessly with documents typically found on arXiv and PMC, offering high accuracy in text recognition, especially for English and other Latin-based languages.
examples: Digitizing academic papers with complex equations
Converting LaTeX documents to editable formats
Extracting data from scientific tables for analysis
Processing academic PDFs for accessible content
Automating dataset creation from a collection of PDFs
input_examples: PDF of a scientific paper from arXiv
Thesis document with extensive use of LaTeX for math
Conference paper PDF with detailed tables and figures
Research article with equations and citations
Archived academic manuscript in PDF format
